newsitem.title: ITALY: Rome to host arts event ahead of food summit.
newsitem.headline: Rome to host arts event ahead of food summit.

text.p: Rome's ancient Colosseum will provide the backdrop to an international arts concert launching next month's U.N. World Food Summit, organisers said on Thursday.

Musicians and dancers from 16 countries will perform during the event on October 27 to be staged in front of the Colosseum. A global village hosting artistic workshops for students would be erected in the same area from October 22.

Officials of the U.N. Food and Agriculture Organisation said the concert was organised to draw public attention to the problem of world hunger ahead of its food summit on November 13-17 at its Rome headquarters.

The arts organisation founded by British rock singer Peter Gabriel, Womad (World of Music and Art), was booking talent for the concert. Among the groups already hired were a Chinese dance troupe and a percussionist ensemble from Zaire.
